protocol.purpose: Test frozen synthetic electrode decoders under isolated recording disturbances, then select one bounded output correction from task reward.

task.target_selection: Deterministic RNG seed from subject seed and session, three sampled without replacement; common across paths and conditions
task.success: Final uninterrupted >=1 second within absolute 0.20 rad, no fall during the target interval
task.fall: Trunk height <0.065 m, up-z <0.45, or nonfinite physics state
task.rest_event: Start of a contiguous nonzero yaw-command interval in rest; count raw and after 1 second washout

final_magnitudes.lost_channels: right half, indices 12:24 replaced by zero

onset_shapes.gradual: linear ramp from onset to onset+18 seconds

disturbance.pairing: Same anatomy, baseline placement, circuit/noise RNG, target sequence and nominal initial state across paths and conditions; feedback makes later neural trajectories different

controller.robot_policy: Official pretrained v8 velstand remains fixed

reconstruction.paired_recordings: Replay identical pre-generated held-out electrode windows and true rate means through all reconstruction models; report MSE separately from robot outcomes

adaptation.condition: Worst isolated sudden disturbance chosen from session 6 frozen results before opening final sessions; record this choice
adaptation.budget: Six matched full episodes of session 7 per seed and path, one candidate per episode; equal frozen control repeats six episodes
adaptation.reward: 100*number of successful targets - sum of final absolute target errors - 20*fall indicator - 0.1*rest false-command events
adaptation.selection: Highest session-7 reward, ties choose earliest candidate; then lock and disable updates on sessions 9 and 10
excluded: per-step heading error as direct command

reported_metrics: rest event count and command occupancy
online adaptation reward and final locked-controller performance
protocol.stopping_rule: Do not retune protocol or adaptation candidates using sessions 9 or 10. Report null or negative outcomes.

runs.latency_definition: 200ms simulated sample acquisition + measured decoder/gate compute; GUI scheduling excluded
runs.wall_latency_definition: Actual elapsed wall time from oldest recorded sample to command application, including scheduling; accelerated batch wall time is not biological real time
